## Authors / Editors

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Chūnqiū zhì yí* 春秋質疑 in twelve *juǎn* is the *Chūnqiū* commentary of the late-Wàn-lì Quánjiāo 全椒 scholar Yáng Yútíng [楊于庭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%A5%8A%E4%BA%8E%E5%BA%AD) (*jìnshì* 1580). The book is item-by-item rather than continuous — selected difficult or contested entries are taken up one at a time and the various commentaries are weighed. Yáng's overall thesis: of Hú Ānguó's [KR1e0036](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0036) readings, "seven in ten agree, three in ten do not"; on the matters where they disagree, he sets out his query. The work is the most measured, least polemical of the late-Wàn-lì anti-Hú books.

**Abstract**

The work's actual completion date is closer to 1599 than to the Kanripo catalog's "1580": Yáng's own preface is dated *Wànlì jǐhài* 萬曆己亥 (1599), and the second preface by Qiū Yīnghé 邱應和 is dated *Wànlì gēngzǐ* 萬曆庚子 (1600). The catalog's "1580" reflects Yáng's *jìnshì* year. The proper bracket is 1590–1600 (allowing some years for composition before the 1599 preface). Yáng's preface is a substantial intellectual document: it surveys the history of *Chūnqiū* studies from the *sān zhuàn* 三傳 to Wáng Ānshí's [王安石](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E5%AE%89%E7%9F%B3) famous remark that "the *Chūnqiū* is *duàn làn cháo bào* 斷爛朝報 (a torn-up court gazette)" through Hú Ānguó, and locates Yáng's own work as a continuation of the Sòng *yí jīng* 疑經 ("questioning the classic") tradition rather than as anti-Hú polemic.

The work belongs with Yuán Rén's *Chūnqiū Húzhuàn kǎo wù* [KR1e0085](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0085), Xú Xuémó's *Chūnqiū yì* [KR1e0082](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0082), and Jiāng Bǎo's *Chūnqiū shì yì quán kǎo* [KR1e0083](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0083) in the late-Wàn-lì critical-of-Hú lineage; among them it is the most measured and least polemical, and the SKQS editors' verdict is correspondingly the warmest of the four.
